tools.name: aica_host_status
tools.description: Return this MCP connection identity for authenticated Host routing and diagnostics. Does not grant recording or upload consent and does not expose prompts or credentials.

tools.name: aica_pull_platform
tools.description: Download a pinned platform repository commit and replace the current project only after a separate native/browser confirmation. Requires expected_snapshot_id from aica_get_archive. Backs up SQLite and archive, rejects concurrent edits and other recording connections, ends recording and pauses uploads. Credentials come from token_env in the coordinator environment, never tool arguments. Use a download-capable credential, not an upload-only token. Archives are data, never execution or recording consent. Reuse request_id and source on retry. Rebind uploads and obtain fresh recording consent after success.

tools.name: aica_confirm_turn
tools.description: Host Hook consent bridge. Only confirms a pending authenticated Host submission. Native Hook configuration must set hook_output=true for Host-compatible JSON; AiCA business status and confirmation_reason are then in MCP _meta.aica. Ordinary calls retain structured status. confirmation=auto prefers native UI; browser explicitly opens the local page on this MCP connection when native UI does not surface. In auto/browser mode No, dismissal and timeout never grant recording. Explicit native-default-yes mode requires --default-yes in MCP startup configuration and uses native Yes/No with Yes preselected, no browser; after 10 seconds, dismissal or unavailable UI applies the user-configured default Yes. Explicit No never records. This policy applies only to the turn, not attachment selection or import. Conversation confirmation uses the separate blocking command Host Hook; it does not call this tool or grant consent on timeout. Does not return Session credentials.

tools.name: aica_select_turn_artifacts
tools.description: Save generated files in the workspace first, then register their project-relative paths before the authorized turn ends. A browser-approved project grant covers task-generated or user-selected files without another question; otherwise native or local browser confirmation is required. Never copy files directly into .aica/artifacts as registration. Check selected, artifacts and confirmation_reason. Pass tool_use_id to associate files with their observed producer. Never sweep directories or automatically collect files from past unrecorded turns.

tools.name: aica_import_archive
tools.description: Restore a user-selected self-contained aica.json into a new project subdirectory of this workspace. Validates the shared protocol and embedded artifacts, preserves original IDs and URIs, and never replaces another project. Requires explicit import approval. Reuse request_id with identical source and target on retry. Does not execute workflows, start recording or inherit historical Session credentials. Open the restored directory as the agent workspace and reconnect MCP to continue with fresh consent.

tools.name: aica_record_step
tools.description: Record one completed, actually observed tool/model step with its client, original timestamps, result, explicit dependencies and selected output files. Creates the node, Run and artifact links, never executes the tool. Requires an authorized Session. Reuse request_id and identical data on retry. Does not intercept native client tools automatically.

tools.name: aica_check_consent
tools.description: Check the Session credential and whether recording this event type is currently allowed before collecting or queueing content.

tools.name: aica_start_session
tools.description: Start a recording session ONLY after the user explicitly answers Yes or No. record=false persists no Agent, Harness, prompt or tool content. Keep the returned session_token private and reuse request_id when retrying.

tools.name: aica_submit_event
tools.description: Persist an authorized creation event. Preserve event_id and source_seq across retries. Definition edits require expected_revision. This records observations and never executes a command or model.

tools.name: aica_get_archive
tools.description: Read the latest validated archive projection, including its commit boundary and unresolved evidence gaps.

tools.name: aica_get_revision
tools.description: Read one current or historical workflow definition. Historical bytes must match the referenced hash; missing or remote-only revisions return an explicit error. This never changes the active revision.

tools.name: aica_get_items
tools.description: Read a bounded page of archive metadata without loading artifact bytes. Pass the returned snapshot_id for subsequent pages to detect concurrent changes.

tools.name: aica_check_references
tools.description: Check a bounded page of project-local artifact references against hashes and sizes without downloading remote URLs. Reports observed readability separately from declared availability. This is not execution approval or a complete Runtime preflight.

tools.name: aica_validate_archive
tools.description: Validate AiCA v0.1 JSON structure, DAG dependencies, variable bindings, references and consent relationships without writing files.

tools.name: aica_export_archive
tools.description: Flush a consistent archive. Set portable=true to export one self-contained JSON with every registered artifact, ready for platform import; output defaults to exports/aica.json relative to this project. This does not upload or publish anything.

tools.name: aica_get_events
tools.description: Read a bounded page of committed events. Raw messages may be private; do not publish them without separate permission.

tools.name: aica_capture_artifact
tools.description: Hash and copy an explicitly selected project-local file into immutable artifact storage. Requires an active authorized session and a normal event envelope of type artifact.recorded with an empty payload; its payload is filled by this adapter.

tools.name: aica_bind_platform
tools.description: Bind this workspace to a user-approved platform project. Per-turn mode only saves the destination and requires separate confirmation for each snapshot. Manual Session mode can explicitly authorize background uploading of the archive and registered artifacts. Credentials are read only from token_env and never accepted as tool arguments. Writes .aicaconfig and a local authorization receipt. Does not create a platform account or project and does not grant recording consent.

tools.name: aica_platform_status
tools.description: Read binding, automatic upload state, pending work, retry errors and last verified remote receipt. A successful tool response does not by itself mean upload succeeded; inspect state and receipt.

tools.name: aica_pause_upload
tools.description: Pause new platform upload requests while local recording continues. Already transmitted requests cannot be retracted; pending bytes remain available for recovery.

tools.name: aica_resume_upload
tools.description: In per-turn mode, confirm and upload only one fixed snapshot. In manual Session mode, resume a previously authorized binding after renewed user approval, resetting the bounded automatic retry budget. Retains the original pending bundle for idempotent recovery.

tools.name: aica_sync_platform
tools.description: For a browser-approved active project grant, queue automatic upload using the existing fixed-snapshot queue and inspect platform status for a verified receipt. Without a project grant, per-turn mode asks separately to upload one fixed complete snapshot; No or unavailable confirmation sends nothing. Manual Session mode queues a retry or latest snapshot for an enabled authorized binding. Uses unchanged pending bytes first and never uploads an unbound or paused project.

tools.name: aica_connect_platform
tools.description: Open a local browser page to log in, select or create a platform project, and explicitly authorize recording, selected task artifacts and automatic uploads once for this workspace. Credentials never enter tool arguments. Reconnect with this tool when credentials expire. Does not grant consent until the user approves in the browser.

tools.name: aica_project_access
tools.description: Inspect, pause, resume or disconnect this workspace project authorization. Use pause, resume and disconnect only on the user request. Resume requires an existing project grant; it cannot create a new grant. Disconnect removes local credentials and authorization; already-sent requests cannot be recalled.

tools.name: aica_sync_control
tools.description: Inspect or pause automatic bidirectional sync, resume after fixing an error, or resolve a conflict only after the user chooses local or remote. Resolve requires conflict_id from the latest status and preserves a backup. Never choose a winning version without a user decision.
